ABI: All seven are ordinary C fastcall; two-argument functions use ECX/EDX without stack arguments. SymbolVisitor is a one-argument fastcall callback; for_each_symbol preserves the indirect callback edge.

data.meaning: Points to the local head during frame allocation; node is exactly16 bytes: next, signed size, signed weighted-use count, SymbolHeader*. Arena3 owns nodes. Ordinary fields introduced at their constructor/consumer.
One active scope-symbol iterator, preserving caller/previous identity and64-bucket traversal. A failed continuation retains original internal-error child and diagnostic literal at use.
Reuses the original canonical EBX/ESI/EDI mask introduced by initialization and save emission; no duplicate mask.
Canonical frame state reused from frame.c; no replacement snapshot or duplicate storage.

dead_stack_word_proof: Native allocator clears two stack DWORDs beginning at its local head. Only the first escapes at7c354. All seven global-pointer sites are in354f0/35680. The counting helper dereferences that address solely as a next-link pointer at offset0, then traverses allocated16-byte nodes (node+4 is size, never head+4). No address of the second word escapes or is read; only the live head is represented.
limits: Pentium case exercises frame-cost early return0; whole386 counting path and internal-error branches retained but unvisited.
Only the first function has reached frame conversion. No completed optimized hello object claimed.

Frame capture represents symbol identity semantically; kind3 field04 is an address identity rather than a frame offset and is not compared as a raw integer. Only variable/temporary offsets and sizes are treated as frame values.
The temporary frame-list head intentionally has the native during-call lifetime; no post-return dangling-head dereference is used as an oracle.
